title: Clean First Person
description: Hides disturbing crit and potion particles from the screen.
body:
# **Clear First Person**

**_Tired of crit and potion particles covering your screen during combat?_**

Clear First Person improves first-person visibility by hiding disgusting particles that cover your screen and make you loose a PvP fight. This reduces visual clutter and helps you focus on PvP without removing important effects happening farther away.

## **Features**
Hides nearby critical hit particles
Hides nearby potion particles
Only affects first-person view
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Designed for PvP players
NEW Customisation Feature added
### **Supported Version**
Minecraft 1.21.x
Fabric Loader
### **Dependencies** 
* Mod-Menu
* Yet Another Configuration Library (YACL) **(only for v1.1.0)**
